explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault in the upstream job. The top-level corpus record n06-r01 has demand_score 9, so it qualifies and should be preserved. Runtime evidence shows select_demand did include n06-r01 in selected_df iteration, but job_1 output omits n06-r01 from both needs and evidence_sources. The normalize function is localized as responsible because its allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r01 and includes n06-r09 instead, causing n06-r01 to be silently filtered before downstream handoff. Job_2 processed the received handoffs consistently, so the observed downstream omission is inherited from job_1.
